messages:
maya-partnerships: quick heads-up — LockBox (HSM vendor) wants a coordinated BYOK + marketplace listing launch targetting mid-May. they want a combined tech + marketing runthrough next week. needs: SSO metadata exchange, SCIM group sync, KMS envelope flow + HSM attestation, and embargo timing. who can own the tech checklist?
raj-sec: I can own tech checklist. high-level items: 1) SAML metadata + cert exchange (IdP SP endpoints), 2) SCIM mappings (groups -> role_ids), 3) KMS integration: we support PKCS#11 + HSM-wrapped envelopes, need key import flow doc, 4) secrets migration plan (existing customers), 5) audit/telemetry hooks.
maya-partnerships: awesome, thx Raj. Tom from LockBox — can you confirm their required telemetry/attestation format and any cert rotation constraints?
tom-lockbox: yes — LockBox requires X.509 attestation statements via our attestation service. cert rotation interval is 90 days by default but can be extended. we expect a metadata endpoint at `https://partners.lockbox.example/.well-known/attestation` and support JWK sets for signing.
lila-product: FYI product constraints: rollout must allow toggling BYOK per-customer and an automatic fallback to managed-key model for mismatch cases. need console flags: `enable_partner_byo`, `partner_id` and `key_policy`. also want a per-route latency SLO note for HSM-backed calls.
elena-legal: embargo window: partners ask for 48h pre-brief to partners only, then coordinated announcement. we need IA signoff on the attestation docs and an NDA addendum for any attestation samples. can partnerships send draft by Thurs so legal can review Fri?
jen-marketing: planning: two-phase launch: (1) marketplace listing + partner page, (2) joint webinar + blog. Marketing needs a partner quote, logo assets, and mutually agreed embargo datetime. also want a joint customer case study — would be great if lockbox has a pilot customer lined up.
bert-distro: distro/marketplace notes — SKU mapping: BYOK will be a separate marketplace offering (reserved+BYOK option). need pricing tier guidance from partnership team; listing requires a 2-week review in marketplace pipeline.
infra-oncall: ops checklist: allowlist LockBox attestation IPs in our egress/NAT, create peering for partner test VPC (staging), add route for `partners.lockbox.example`. also we'll need to open TCP 443 and restrict to cert-based mTLS for KMS endpoints.
raj-sec: quick SCIM mapping idea (sample):
```
scim_mapping:
  external_group: "LockBox-Admins"
  redwood_role: "platform_admin"
  auto_provision: true
```
we should finalize role names asap.
maya-partnerships: good sample. action items: Raj (tech checklist + sample flows) by Tue EOD; Tom (confirm attestation endpoint + sample cert) by Tue; Elena (review NDA addendum + embargo) by Fri; Jen (draft announcement timeline + webinar plan) by Fri; Bert (start marketplace intake) by Wed; Infra (staging peering + firewall ticket) by Wed. sync meeting Wed 11am PT?
tom-lockbox: Wed 11am PT works. we'll bring our SRE and product lead.
elena-legal: noted — will prioritize embargo review for Fri.
jen-marketing: will draft partner-friendly announcement timeline and circulate a one-pager before Wed.
bert-distro: opening marketplace intake ticket now.
infra-oncall: filing firewall/peering ticket (INC-7721) and will post link in thread.
maya-partnerships: sweet. if anyone has specific compliance or cert examples, paste them here. otherwise see you Wed 11am — I'll post calendar invite. :thumbsup:
raj-sec: pushing a tiny follow-up — we should also document KMS key rotation semantics for HSM-wrapped keys (hot vs cold rotation) and failure fallback behavior. adding to checklist.
maya-partnerships: noted, Raj. thanks everyone!
